janus.desc_en: Janus, the ancient Roman god of doors and gates, a dignified man about 50 with ONE head that has TWO bearded faces looking in opposite directions (one face looks left, the other looks right, sharing one head of short curly gray-brown hair), early Roman Republic clothing: a long off-white wool toga with a dark red border draped over a tunic, leather sandals, holding a large old bronze key in one hand and a long wooden staff in the other, no armor, no crown
